# Feature Design Contract

Cover outcome and beneficiary, current behavior, actors/permissions, primary
flow, applicable states/failures, behavioral rules, interface impact,
acceptance examples, genuinely different options and choice, unresolved product
decisions, explicit non-goals, and implementation proof.
